title: psacalium tussilaginoides
intro: Psacalium tussilaginoides, commonly known as Mexican fever plant or yerba de las fiebres, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to Mexico and Central America. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Psacalium tussilaginoides include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory infections, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential side effects of using Psacalium tussilaginoides as a medicinal plant.
